answer: At the quay haven, an applicant locks a 110-unit bond and receives one facet of a three-facet prism key, sealed behind a 25-minute verifiable delay. For six nights they play an eight-second whisper tone into the haven ledger at a random minute posted by that day's beacon. Two night clerks from non-overlapping watches countersign the tone's 16-band spectrogram. If a second packet reuses the same facet, or a whisper clip sits within Hamming distance 3 of a prior spectrogram, the facets recombine and both bonds are seized. The quay haven graduates at most one agent every fourteen days.
